description: Turn the many ways a phone number gets typed into one E.164 string: strips spacing, brackets, the 00 international prefix and the national trunk zero people include out of habit. Returns country, calling code, national number, and whether the length matches that country's numbering plan. Line type (mobile / fixed) is reported ONLY for countries whose ranges are unambiguous and is null elsewhere with a reason — never guessed. Offline: it does not check that the number is assigned or reachable.

country.description: Calling code, if the number has no +

name: phone_check

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.
